name: NUST Need Based Financial Aid
coverage: Partial or full academic expenditures; interest-free loan/deferment options may also be available.
duration_note: NUST states need-based scholarships can cover partial/full academic expenditures for up to 4 years for undergraduate students.
eligibility_logic: Financial need is assessed from household financial information; admission is on merit.

name: FAST-NUCES Merit Scholarship
coverage: Full tuition fee for the stated eligible top position holders, subject to FAST rules.
eligibility_logic: FAST Peshawar FAQ states scholarships are awarded to top three position holders in each examination-board group and top three in the NU admission merit list, subject to stated continuation conditions.

name: FAST-NUCES Interest-Free Study Loan
coverage: Tuition-fee financial assistance in the form of an interest-free study loan.
eligibility_logic: FAST states assistance is for bright/indigent students and is subject to renewal based on academic performance and financial need.

name: COMSATS Scholarships & Financial Aid
coverage: Full and partial scholarships/financial aid may be available through university and external funding agencies.
eligibility_logic: Exact eligibility depends on the specific scholarship; do not treat this record as a single scholarship with one universal rule.
